name: Odontoid Fracture
definition: Fracture of the odontoid process of C2, common in older adults after low-energy falls and in younger patients after high-energy trauma.

redFlags.item: Elderly patient with persistent neck pain after fall

investigations.principle: CT is central for diagnosis; MRI assesses ligament, cord and occult instability when indicated.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Treatment depends on fracture type, displacement, age, healing potential and stability.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva-bhagna phenotype may be documented only after modern fracture care.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the odontoid process of C2, common in older adults after low-energy falls and in younger patients after high-energy trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
